The inquest identified that there was insufficient staff training to deal with complex hoarder cases.

Other safety assessments such as a fire assessment and/or environmental health assessment were not requested despite their being a clear need.
The council "flow chart" was clearly not fit for purpose to assist staff in progressing hoarder support and assistance and was focussed on enforcement procedures rather than tenant support.
It was entirely unclear what options were available (if any) when the first plan of assistance completely failed, leaving the vulnerable tenant excluded from her property with no forward plan.
